shared_cause: The infrastructure is experiencing failures due to disk space exhaustion on the host. This is demonstrated by the host disk encountering a 'build aborted: no space left on device' error, which has also caused the metricool:fwtx_dao upload worker to fail with 'upload worker: OSError [Errno 28] no space left on device'.
reason: co-occurring faults on host:mac/disk, metricool:fwtx_dao are tied together by evidence cited from each; the relationship was inferred, not traversed
